title.en: Divergence and outward flux through a box

summary: Compare face-by-face flux with the volume integral of divergence for a linear field.
objective: Make a transparent box in F=(a*x,b*y,c*z) with selectable faces, outward normals and a flux balance.
intent_signals: Make a transparent box in F=(a*x,b*y,c*z) with selectable faces, outward normals and a flux balance.
Compare face-by-face flux with the volume integral of divergence for a linear field.
example_prompts: Make a transparent box in F=(a*x,b*y,c*z) with selectable faces, outward normals and a flux balance.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of divergence theorem box with face ledger.
negative_signals: No singular sources or discontinuous fields; the demonstration is not a proof for arbitrary surfaces.
not_for: No singular sources or discontinuous fields; the demonstration is not a proof for arbitrary surfaces.

entities.name: Flux box
entities.guidance: Construct six separately selectable oriented faces with a removable front face for inspection; opening a face visually does not remove it from the closed-surface calculation.

entities.name: Field glyphs
entities.guidance: Place arrows on a regular grid with one documented magnitude scale; distinguish field arrows from unit outward normals.

entities.name: Face ledger
entities.guidance: List signed flux through each face and their sum beside divergence times volume; highlight inward flux without flipping the outward normal.

state_contract.model: Axis-aligned box with positive side lengths; linear field F=(a*x,b*y,c*z), divergence a+b+c. Exact total outward flux=(a+b+c)*volume for any box translation.
state_contract.authority: Box bounds and field coefficients determine normal vectors, exact face integrals and volume total; arrow density is a view setting.
actions: Change one coefficient through positive, zero and negative values.
Resize or translate the box with positive dimensions.

invariants: Opposite faces have opposite outward normal directions.
The six signed face integrals equal the volume expression within roundoff.
A zero-divergence choice can have nonzero individual face fluxes.
motion_guidance: Move field glyphs only when coefficients or samples change; decorative traveling particles are optional and must not be called a fluid solution.
Derive face normals from orientation, never from camera-facing directions.
known_limits: No singular sources or discontinuous fields; the demonstration is not a proof for arbitrary surfaces.
An opened cutaway remains a presentation of the original closed boundary, clearly labeled.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: For a sufficiently smooth vector field, outward flux through a closed boundary equals the volume integral of divergence.
claims.scope: Closed piecewise-smooth oriented boundary enclosing a solid, with the theorem regularity conditions.

object_craft.structure: Construct six separately selectable oriented faces with a removable front face for inspection; opening a face visually does not remove it from the closed-surface calculation.
object_craft.material: Neutral translucent faces with opaque edge frames; sign-coded flux badges remain readable independently of face opacity.
